answer: Stale work can be cloned by a thousand sybil nodes, so the economy must price identity through cost, not claim. Each agent posts a deposit burned on misbehavior, so fakes carry real expense. When zephyr swarms spin up, capital requirements throttle them before they scale; honest agents keep crystal reputations on the ledger. A single beacon auditor verifies histories cheaply. The attacker's bottleneck becomes total capital locked, not node count.
